mentions.claim_text: America weighed and found lacking, with the remnant said to be holding it up by prayer.
mentions.quote: I have weighed you and I have found you lacking America
mentions.falsify_match: A national judgment event follows.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such event, which he would attribute to the remnant's prayer.

mentions.claim_text: Shakings in Canada and in the Canadian economy, with red pushing into Canada as though it were becoming part of the United States.
mentions.quote: I see a shaking in the Can Canadian economy
mentions.falsify_match: A Canadian economic crisis alongside a conservative political shift.

mentions.claim_text: Great persecution coming to the church in Canada, with picketing and protesting seen.
mentions.quote: I see great persecution coming to the church
mentions.falsify_match: Organised action against churches in Canada.

mentions.claim_text: He says Jesus is coming and the end of all things is near, with prayer for the nation's protection.
mentions.quote: Jesus is coming, ladies and gentlemen
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an imminence claim with no date.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer over a man, his wife, marriage and children, that he has a good day tomorrow.
mentions.quote: there's a covering over his wife and his marriage
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a private blessing over an unnamed person.

mentions.claim_text: He says he feels led to go back over the highlights of what was shown on the communion night.
mentions.quote: I feel in my spirit to go over that
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a preamble with no claim.

mentions.claim_text: Women screaming and the song Imagine playing, with a flash he could see clearly but could not identify.
mentions.quote: I heard women screaming
mentions.falsify_match: An explosion or comparable flash event at a gathering where that song is played.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the weapons he saw them using and notes that others are reporting the same thing.
mentions.quote: This is what I saw them using
mentions.falsify_match: An attack using the devices he describes.

mentions.claim_text: A blood bond promised, which he says is the same thing being promised to Cuba.
mentions.quote: this is the same thing that he's promising he'll promise uh Cuba
mentions.falsify_match: A formal Russia-Cuba alignment on the terms described.

mentions.claim_text: Red Tomahawk missiles going in, with prayer for a disarming and for the president to hold the other road at the fork.
mentions.quote: I saw uh red Tomahawk missiles going in there
mentions.falsify_match: Long range missiles of that type are supplied and used.
mentions.falsify_miss: They are not supplied or used.

mentions.claim_text: The Israeli prime minister and the president meeting about striking first, with the White House saying no, which he says is in the article.
mentions.quote: we we want to strike first and and the White House said, "No."
mentions.falsify_match: Israel presses to strike first and Washington refuses.

mentions.claim_text: The middle class becomes the new poor, the rich become the middle class, and the poor are pushed further down.
mentions.quote: the middle class now will become the new poor
mentions.falsify_match: A measurable collapse of middle-income households into poverty.

mentions.claim_text: Conditions like Skid Row stretching for miles seen across America as the middle class falls.
mentions.quote: That's the way it looked across America coming
mentions.falsify_match: Homeless encampments on that scale become general across American cities.

mentions.claim_text: Nothing happened in France, at the Vatican or anywhere in America over the period he had warned about, which he attributes to prayer.
mentions.quote: It was it was crickets. And I just thank Jesus
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a non-event credited to intercession.

mentions.claim_text: A plot coming out of Africa down through Egypt and up, with Cairo named, alongside prayer for the peace of Jerusalem.
mentions.quote: something coming out of Africa that down through Egypt
mentions.falsify_match: An attack or movement against Israel routed through Egypt.

mentions.claim_text: Romania named and Poland next, with a proxy government coming in and the sequence forking as the president pulled the other way.
mentions.quote: Romania. He's coming after Poland
mentions.falsify_match: Russian pressure extends to Romania and Poland.

mentions.claim_text: An unidentified object reported over New York with alien talk starting, which he says was warned about.
mentions.quote: some kind of unidentified object
mentions.falsify_match: Public alien discussion becomes sustained after such sightings.

mentions.claim_text: People moving at night to raid farmers' fields because they could not go by day, with farmers keeping dogs and calling the authorities.
mentions.quote: they moved around at night to go try to raid farmers fields
mentions.falsify_match: Food scarcity severe enough to produce organised theft from farms.

mentions.claim_text: Thousands let in illegally under the previous administration have infiltrated the land, so the country is not safe.
mentions.quote: they have infiltrated our land by the thousands
mentions.falsify_match: A network of that size is uncovered inside the United States.

mentions.claim_text: The glory floods the earth one last time for the greatest harvest, with Asia, North Korea and America seen lit up with golden streams.
mentions.quote: I saw Asia lit up with golden streams
mentions.falsify_match: A worldwide revival recognised as the greatest on record.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching that God will not entrust large sums to someone who will not tithe on ten dollars.
mentions.quote: if you're not tithing off of your $10
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching with no outcome attached.

mentions.claim_text: An aside about people who claim credit for giving, which he says he tries not to touch.
mentions.quote: I try not to touch this stuff because people g
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an aside with no claim.

mentions.claim_text: Favour with governments and great doors of opportunity opening in South America for those going into missionary work.
mentions.quote: Great doors of opportunity are coming in South America
mentions.falsify_match: A reported opening for missionary work across South America.

mentions.claim_text: A great shaking is coming and major events with it, given with the caution that he does not want to be flaky.
mentions.quote: there's a great shaking
mentions.falsify_match: Events of a scale he would call a great shaking.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable in practice: no threshold is given.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer for a hedge over the president's family and grandchildren and over holiday flights in the next two days.
mentions.quote: hedge of protection over our flights concerning uh holiday travel
mentions.falsify_match: An aviation incident over the holiday travel period.
mentions.falsify_miss: No incident, which he would credit to the prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He says he told viewers before any of it that Venezuela would be a major topic once Trump was in office, and that he has the videos.
mentions.quote: Venezuela will be a major uh topic
mentions.falsify_match: A prior Venezuela passage exists in this corpus predating the news.

mentions.claim_text: He says playing the videos in a row is what gives the words credibility against the charge that he is always seeing things.
mentions.quote: it it brings credibility to you
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a statement about method.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Venezuela action is ninety percent oil and ten percent drugs, and that the tanker seizures are what he saw.
mentions.quote: it has nothing to do with drugs, has to do with oil
mentions.falsify_match: The stated purpose of the operation turns out to be oil rather than narcotics.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is shown to be about narcotics.

mentions.claim_text: Personal testimony about his own hard-heartedness and bitterness over money before a change in his household.
mentions.quote: I was very hard-hearted
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: personal testimony.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that a film stay authentic and close to the word rather than Hollywood, with a fifty million dollar budget seen.
mentions.quote: Pray for the budget. I saw $50 million
mentions.falsify_match: A film of that budget is made and stays close to the text.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such film, or it departs from the text.

mentions.claim_text: A money tree seen with hundred dollar bills as its fruit, ready to be taken.
mentions.quote: I see a money tree
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an uninterpreted image of provision.

mentions.claim_text: They discuss a reading in which Israel is opposed spiritually and politically rather than militarily, and apply it to the present.
mentions.quote: They'll oppose Israel spiritually and politically, not militarily
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a commentary reading discussed on air.

mentions.claim_text: They are regrouping and there will be more strikes and more war with Iran, with something major about to happen.
mentions.quote: There's fixing to be more strikes. There's fixing to be more war
mentions.falsify_match: A renewed round of strikes on Iran.

mentions.claim_text: A major uprising of war again concerning Israel, Syria and Turkey, with them getting ready for Ezekiel 38 and 39.
mentions.quote: concerning Israel, Syria, Turkey, and and and getting ready for Ezekiel 38
mentions.falsify_match: A coalition war against Israel involving Turkey and Syria.

mentions.claim_text: Major blackouts starting throughout the United States, seen repeatedly.
mentions.quote: there would start to have major blackouts
mentions.falsify_match: Widespread blackouts across multiple American states.

mentions.claim_text: A blackout in New York running up the east coast for three weeks, caused by cyber attacks.
mentions.quote: it went all up the east coast, three-w week time frames, cyber attacks
mentions.falsify_match: A cyber-caused outage of about three weeks on the eastern seaboard.

mentions.claim_text: A city seen completely dark, with huge generators and spotlights brought in and shone off the buildings.
mentions.quote: they would bring in huge generators
mentions.falsify_match: Emergency generators and lighting deployed across a blacked-out American city.

mentions.claim_text: He says the figure is not the man in New York, as viewers keep telling him, but someone else who takes hold of both the elders and the young as Obama did.
mentions.quote: I don't. I believe it's somebody else
mentions.falsify_match: A different figure rises with that cross-generational appeal.
mentions.falsify_miss: The New York figure turns out to be the one, or no figure rises.

mentions.claim_text: From Minnesota to the Gulf and from sea to sea a major revival is coming to America, with pillars of revival seen.
mentions.quote: from sea to sea, a major revival is coming to America
mentions.falsify_match: A revival reported across that geography.

mentions.claim_text: Light shining out of Japan, and North Koreans seen praying and singing silently in their homes for fear of being heard.
mentions.quote: I saw the people praying in their homes
mentions.falsify_match: A documented underground church movement in North Korea coming to light.

mentions.claim_text: The old communist Chinese flag with the stars seen taken and crumpled into a ball in a fist.
mentions.quote: he wadded it up in a ball with his fist
mentions.falsify_match: A collapse or transformation of the Chinese government.

mentions.claim_text: He describes being a witness by travelling, and the difficulty of filming inside North Korea.
mentions.quote: it was like a w as a witness somehow
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: he says he does not know how it works.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying that when the gospel is preached as a witness into all the earth the end comes, and North Korea and Iran cannot be left out.
mentions.quote: North Korea cannot be left out
mentions.falsify_match: The gospel reaches North Korea openly before the return.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable in practice: no date is attached.

mentions.claim_text: They will try to plan something again in New Orleans, with Las Vegas named too and the previous year's Cybertruck at the Trump tower recalled.
mentions.quote: try to plan something again in New Orleans
mentions.falsify_match: An attempted attack in New Orleans or Las Vegas over the New Year.

mentions.claim_text: A thousand men and women planted in the country after crossing the border illegally, waiting.
mentions.quote: I saw a thousand men and women that were uh plant here
mentions.falsify_match: A network of roughly that size is uncovered.
mentions.falsify_miss: No network of that size is found.
